target_customer: Software developers who use VS Code and pay for AI coding assistance
problem: GitHub Copilot completions were limited in quality, bracket handling and model choice; Double aims to be a higher performance alternative.
business_model: Subscription developer tool (VS Code extension); pricing not captured

founders.name: Wesley Yue
previous_startups: Ninja, last-mile delivery (acquired in 2022 per the YC page; raised 2M dollars)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a single founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wrapping frontier models in an editor extension with fast autocomplete, multi-cursor and import handling is standard engineering with latency challenges.

defensibility.rationale: The product depends on third party models and runs inside VS Code; copying features is easy for Copilot, Cursor and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented with dated sources; the market became dominated by Copilot and AI IDEs. The docs site still lists a changelog and Claude 3.5 Sonnet support from October 2024.

market_need_then: Developers were adopting AI completion in 2022 to 2023 and Copilot had millions of users; the YC page claims better completions and model choice as the gap.

identity.voice_and_tone: performance focused; tagline engineered for performance

brand_strength.rationale: A search for brand coverage returned only unrelated companies. The name Double is shared with an accounting software firm and other startups, which hurts searchability.

outcome_analysis: Double is an active two person coding assistant with no verified funding and no exit found. It faced strong incumbents (Copilot) and fast moving AI IDE competitors, and its defensibility is low because it relies on third party models. Public sources do not show traction, so the outcome is unclear.
notes: Unverified funding: aggregators list about 500K seed or pre-seed with Y Combinator; no primary source, so no round is recorded. A YC launch post title mentions an earlier GPT bot product. Dated 2023 competitor sources were not found (results were 2025 and 2026 listicles), so the list is empty. Other companies named Double (accounting 6.5M Series A, doubleAI 200M) are unrelated. The recorded 500K round rests on aggregators only (VCBacked lists seed or pre-seed), no date.
